EmailTemplate.name: PMC SS Warehouse/Plant Outage
EmailTemplate.subject: Warehouse/ PLANT OUTAGE (planned or unplanned)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Case.Account}, {!Case.PMC_SS_Location__c}/{!Case.PMC_SS_Plant__c} has reported an outage {!Today} .To prevent immediate inconvenience to your shipping plans we wish to advise the following orders identified.
Customer PO number Mosaic order number
We apologize for the impact to your business. Operations are scheduled to resume MM/DD/YY/ ASAP. Once the plant is operational, we will send notification so you may resume product pick up. Please reach out to your Customer Service Representative for further questions
{!Case.OwnerFullName}
